seo_desc: Jimmy's Hometown Pizzeria, 920 West Swanzey Road, West Swanzey NH. A slice of home. Call (603) 903-0200 or (603) 903-0201.
about: Jimmy's Hometown Pizzeria is a pizzeria at 920 West Swanzey Road in West Swanzey, NH. Its own website greets visitors with "A Slice of Home."
Call the shop on (603) 903-0200 or (603) 903-0201 to ask about today's menu.
menu_note: The shop's menu is published only as images on its own website, so it is not shown here. Call (603) 903-0200 for items and prices.
findings: Squarespace site: the homepage is just "A Slice of Home", the address, phone numbers and hours; no description of the shop or food.
The Menu page is images only, with no text, so it cannot be searched or read easily on a phone.
The Delivery page has no content beyond the shared header and footer.
The only store is a merch shop (cap, tee, hoodie); there is no online food ordering.
A scrolling hours banner repeats the same line four times.
Two phone numbers are listed: (603) 903-0200 and (603) 903-0201. The first is used for the call button.
questions: Can you send your menu with prices as text? The current menu is images only, so none is shown.
What are your current hours? They were not available to us in readable form, so none are shown.
Do you have photos of your food and shop we may use?
Do you want online ordering, and if so through which service? Is delivery offered?
Which of the two phone numbers should customers call?
Is the Facebook page linked the shop's page? Do you have Instagram?
What is the ZIP code you want shown in the address?
